title: CFinBench: A Comprehensive Chinese Financial Benchmark for Large Language Models

live_model.evidence: 'two API-based LLMs, i.e., ChatGPT (gpt-3.5-turbo-0125) and GPT4 (gpt-4-turbo)' (Section 4.2); OpenCompass, temperature and top-p 1.0 with greedy decoding

prompt.location: Appendix C, Figures 5-7 (zero-shot, few-shot and CoT prompt examples with English translations)
prompt.note: Answer-only prompts; input limited to 2048 tokens, output 64.

claim.metric: accuracy (answer-only, 0-shot, Average over Subject/Qualification/Practice/Law, test split)

data.source: CFinBench (99,100 questions; project page and GitHub release); test split is 80% of the validation+test pool

notes: n_items computed from the 2:8 validation/test split (exact count not printed). Scoring weights single/multiple/judgment questions 0.4/0.4/0.2. Unversioned 'gpt-4-turbo' resolved by the date rule (NAACL 2025).
